packageRules.description: The Python constraints in Mise-generated pipx sidecars mirror mise.toml; Renovate must not update them independently.

Nothing in this tree names a first-party reference with a ref today — every one is $/. This rule stays anyway: a future step naming another turboBasic repository by tag is meant to track a moving major, and a digest pin here would defeat that on purpose.

This pin version-locks the vendored .specify/ and speckit skills, and only `mise run spec-kit-upgrade` re-syncs them — so the bump is half a change until a human runs it. Grouped alone, never with anything mergeable as-is.
prBodyNotes: :warning: docs/ai-instructions.md's Specs section owns the upgrade procedure — read it before merging this alone.

packageRules.description: Group the custom workflow pin with PEP 621's commitizen dependency update.
Update uv.lock for in-range Commitizen releases and group it with the workflow pin.

customManagers.description: The only fact this reads is the CZ_VERSION line; tests/test_commit_grammar.py pre-flights this same pattern against that line, and is what proves the workflow and the lockfile still agree after Renovate moves it.
